text:
pagerbot: PAGER: [SEV2] auth spike + possible log push containing auth headers. Pager routed to oncall @sara. Incident bridge: #incident-1746667777 created.

sara: Oncall here. Starting triage — confirm scope and containment.

dan: I'm pulling logs now, tailing the forwarder. Seeing repeated 401s, and a few forwarded requests that include header dumps. IPs: 18.203.x.x, 52.12.x.x, 35.170.x.x.

maria: Found S3 object in 'staging-logs-forwarder' created ~10m ago. Snippet contains 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbg...' (truncated). Looks like token fragments captured by debug logging.

security: Treat as sensitive. Assume short-lived tokens could be reconstructed. Immediate actions: rotate impacted service tokens, contain forwarder, and audit for customer data. Legal may need to be notified depending on results.

sara: Action list: 1) @dan scope all objects and list candidate buckets/keys 2) @maria confirm who/what wrote the object + timestamp 3) @leo check infra & whether any external fs or forwarder endpoints exposed. I'll start containment: disable forwarder trigger and block egress.

leo: Confirmed: ingestion lambda (svc-forwarder) in prod-us-east-1; not on Dedicated.

ops-bot: Runbook recommendation: immediate token revoke for svc-forwarder, rotate env vars, redeploy canary, and enable prefix-level bucket ACLs.

dan: Objects found: s3://staging-logs-forwarder/2026-03-18/ingest-1746667500.log.gz created by role svc-forwarder-role. 6 lines include 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbG...' fragments. No long-lived AWS keys present.

maria: Downloaded and redacted object to /tmp/repro. No obvious customer PII in sampled lines but will scan full file.

sara: Containment: disabled lambda trigger, applied SG egress deny for forwarder host, stopped the forwarder task. Starting rotation plan next.

security: Rotation steps (executing now):
1) Revoke current service tokens / invalidate sessions for svc-forwarder
2) Issue new credentials and rotate env in CI/CD
3) Deploy canary forwarder in prod-us-east-1 with reduced scope
4) Audit request traces for last 24h for signs of replay or exfil
5) If customer secrets present, prepare comms with legal + CS.

dan: Running revoke command (placeholder): `# aws iam deactivate-service-specific-credential --user-name svc-forwarder`
Updating thread with status when done.

maria: Legal pinged (legal@redwood). They've acked and asked to preserve evidence; do not delete objects. I've saved a redacted copy to secure artifact store.

security: If we find enough contiguous token material to reconstruct, escalate to full rotation + external notice. For now: limited exposure posture.

sara: Note on customer impact: no customer reports yet. Ingestion backlog minimal. If queue >10k or retries spike, escalate SRE.

leo: I'll watch for retries and increase in error budget. Owning overnight watch if needed.

ops-bot: Checklist added to incident doc: revoke -> rotate -> canary -> audit -> notify.

sara: Handoff in 30m to night oncall @leo. Please post any follow-ups here and tag if you need urgent re-escalation. :white_check_mark:

security: Keep this thread as the source of truth for timeline and artifacts.

sara: Thanks team — good progress. Will update bridge with final status after rotation completes.
